summary: AT&T Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to report its first-quarter 2026 earnings. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings release, which does not constitute a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The disclosure includes financial statements and exhibits but no event triggering special-situations classification.
